title: Madeira Sea Conditions: Is the Sea Calm for a Boat Trip?
description: Is the sea calm in Madeira? How wind, swell and the sheltered south coast shape a boat trip from Funchal, season by season, and where to check the forecast.
heroAlt: A small white private motorboat on calm blue water below the south coast cliffs of Madeira
keywords: is the sea calm in Madeira
best time of day for a boat trip
